empty_body: Set up the local engine, then start dictation. Your words will appear here.
copy_failed: The clipboard is unavailable. Your text is still here.
runtime_missing: This development build needs a verified runtime bundle. See the setup guide; no download happens automatically.
runtime_invalid: Runtime verification failed. No microphone was opened. Check the trusted bundle and retry.
installation_failed: Installation failed or was cancelled. Check your connection and try again.
model_unavailable: The local model could not start. Check installation and try again.
microphone_unavailable: The microphone could not open. Check system permissions or choose a different input.
invalid_audio: The recording could not be used. Check your microphone and try again.
transcription_failed: Transcription failed. Nothing was copied or pasted. Try again.
cancelled: Dictation cancelled. Nothing was copied or pasted.
cleanup_body: Local recognition is independent of your account. Connect ChatGPT below, choose an available model, then explicitly allow transcript sharing. No API-key fallback is used.
history_body: Completed dictations are saved locally. Recordings are not saved by this build.
history_not_saved: Your result is available, but history could not be saved. Copy it before closing.
storage_unavailable: No data folder is available. Settings and history will not be saved.
storage_unreadable: Existing data could not be read safely. It has not been changed; saving is disabled.
settings_not_saved: Settings could not be saved. Existing data has not been overwritten.
shortcut_body: Tap to start; tap again to finish. Registration can be unavailable or conflict with another app.
shortcut_unavailable: The global shortcut could not be registered. Use the dictation button instead.
vocabulary_body: Comma-separated names or terms. Phonon uses up to 25 distinct hints; it does not automatically replace words.
engine_residency: The engine unloads after 15 minutes without use.
delivery_hint: Windows: dictation started with the global shortcut pastes into the original app only while it remains focused. Text stays on the clipboard. Start here uses Copy instead; other platforms also use Copy.
recording_limit: Recordings stop after 2 minutes. In Saytwig, Escape cancels active dictation.
empty_result: No speech was recognized. Try again.
worker_failed: The background worker could not start. Restart Saytwig.
install_note: The model download is explicit. Runtime and model files are verified before use.
overlay_unavailable: The recording overlay could not open. Use the controls in Saytwig.
account_unavailable: The account request could not complete. Check the connection and try again.
account_store_unavailable: Protected account storage is unavailable or locked. No plaintext fallback is used.
account_timed_out: Sign-in timed out. Continue sign-in to try again.
account_permission: ChatGPT plan use has not been granted. Cleanup remains unavailable.
account_reconnect: Sign in again to use this account.
logout_local_only: Local credentials were cleared. Remote revocation was not confirmed; disconnect Saytwig in ChatGPT Settings if needed.
models_unavailable: Available cleanup models could not be loaded. Nothing was shared.
sharing_explanation: When enabled, completed transcripts are sent to your selected ChatGPT account for cleanup. Audio stays local. Original text is kept if cleanup fails. Connecting an account alone does not enable sharing.
cleanup_failed: Cleanup did not complete. The original transcript is retained.
model_none: Choose a model before enabling cleanup.
desktop_required: Saytwig needs a native desktop session. No microphone or account was opened.
window_failed: Saytwig could not open a native window. A supported desktop session is required.
paste_dispatched: Paste sent to the original app. Check the insertion; text remains on the clipboard.
paste_focus_changed: The original app is no longer focused. Nothing was pasted; your result is ready to Copy.
paste_modifiers_held: Keyboard modifiers were held. Nothing was pasted; release them and use Copy.
paste_partial: Some paste input was dispatched. Check the original app before using Copy to avoid inserting twice.
paste_failed: Automatic paste was not confirmed. Check the original app before using Copy; your result is kept here.
paste_unavailable: No supported external paste target. This dictation will stay here for Copy.
